E is the midpoint of D=(b,0) and B=(2b,0), so \(E=\left(\frac{3b}{2},0\right)\).

F is the midpoint of B=(2b,0) and C=(2c,2d), so \(F=(b+c,d)\).

Area of \(\triangle AEF\):
\[
\frac12 \cdot AE \cdot \text{height} = \frac12 \cdot \frac{3b}{2} \cdot d = \frac{3bd}{4}.
\]

Area of \(\triangle ABC\):
\[
\frac12 \cdot AB \cdot \text{height} = \frac12 \cdot 2b \cdot 2d = 2bd = 96,
\]
so \(bd=48\).

Thus:
\[
\text{Area of } \triangle AEF = \frac{3(48)}{4} = 36.
\]

\boxed{36}
